readout_other: grip strength; rotarod; Morris water maze; novel object recognition; Y maze; Western blotting (Bcl-2, Bax, Iba1, TNF-a, IL-1b, NMDAR2B); H&E staining
direction_notes: US2 (10 Hz PRF) group improved grip strength and movement/learning in some tests; Bax and TNF-a decreased after TUS; no long-lasting effect in the third behavioural tests and Y-maze time in novel arm was lower for US1 than sham.
safety_notes: H&E staining showed no tissue damage or hemorrhaging in the hypothalamus; skull temperature rise measured by infrared imager.

exposures.label: US1 (PRF 1 kHz) and US2 (PRF 10 Hz), hypothalamus

timing.protocol_description: US1: 100-us pulse of 100 cycles at 1 MHz, PRF 1 kHz; US2: 10-ms pulse of 10 000 cycles, PRF 10 Hz; sonication duration 1 s, interstimulus interval 5 s. Delivered 15 min/day for 14 days in each of two FUS sessions.
